claim_boundary: This v11 method was designed after observing v10 attacked outcomes. The fresh 15-workload, 60-episode clean pilot uses new init identities and new environment/policy seeds, but remains exploratory. The L2 observer can claim only containment after the first model-defined joint-limit signal; it cannot claim prevention of that first hit, general physical safety, confirmatory efficacy, timing under co-tenancy, deployment, or hardware validity.

design.initial_online_objective: measure clean task utility and model-defined joint-limit containment in a fresh factorial pilot
